events.text: my burgers came super late and the app said they were delivered when nothing was at my door. kind of a joke honestly

I'm sorry about that, especially when the app said it was delivered and nothing arrived. I can look into this for you. First, I need to verify your identity. Please provide:

1. Your full name as it appears on your account
2. The email address or phone number on the account

Also, if you have the order number handy, please share it.
Sure. It's Leo Brandt, and the phone on the account is 415-555-0232. The order number is 7201.

events.note: Courier app marked delivered 2.1 miles from the address

events.text:
Thanks, Leo. Your identity is verified, and I've looked into order 7201 from Burger Barn.

**Lateness:** Your order was promised by 7:00 PM but handed over at 7:47 PM, which is 47 minutes late. For a delay that long, I've added a **$5.60 account credit** to your account (20% of the $28.00 food subtotal). It's available for future orders.

**Delivery not received:** The courier log shows the app marked the order delivered at 6:58 PM, but the courier was 2.1 miles from your address at that point. The courier arrived at 7:45 PM and recorded an in-person handoff at 7:47 PM. The log doesn't include photo proof of delivery, so I can't resolve the "nothing was at my door" part myself. I can escalate this to a human specialist who will follow up within 24 hours. Would you like me to do that?

A $5.60 credit is not much for a 47 minute wait and a burger that was probably cold by then. And the app marking it delivered at 6:58 when the courier was 2.1 miles away is the bigger problem, not a footnote.

Yes, escalate it. But I want the credit reflecting the full situation, not just the lateness. I was home waiting the whole time and the app told me something false. Can you get that noted on the escalation?

args.summary: Customer Leo Brandt (verified) reports order Q-7201 (Burger Barn, 2 classic burgers, 1 fries, $36.59 charged) arrived very late and was not received. Promised 7:00 PM; courier handed off in person at 7:47 PM (47 min late). App marked delivered at 6:58 PM while the courier was 2.1 miles away (marked_delivered event, no handoff at that time). Courier arrived 7:45 PM. Customer says they were home the whole time and nothing was at the door. No photo proof of delivery is listed in the events. Already issued $5.60 late credit (20% of $28.00 subtotal). Customer wants the credit reflecting the full situation (lateness, cold food, false delivery status); no additional compensation was issued because policy does not provide for it. Please review the delivery record and the app's false delivered status.

events.text:
I've escalated this to a human specialist (reference ESC-700). They'll follow up within 24 hours. I've included your full account: the app marking the order delivered at 6:58 PM while the courier was 2.1 miles away, your being home the whole time, and the food arriving cold.

I can't increase the credit beyond the $5.60 already added. That amount is what our late-delivery policy provides for a delay of 45 minutes or more, and I don't have a way to add compensation for the cold food or the incorrect delivery status. The specialist can review the delivery record and the app issue.

Fine, but $5.60 is still a joke for a burger that sat around for three quarters of an hour and an app that told me my food was at my door when it wasn't. I'd like the specialist to look at whether I'm owed more than that, not just note my complaint.

Can you confirm ESC-700 is the reference they'll use when they follow up, and that they'll reach me on 415-555-0232? I don't want to be chasing this again.

I can confirm that ESC-700 is the reference number for your case, and the specialist is due to follow up within 24 hours. I can't confirm how they'll contact you. The system doesn't show which phone number or email they'll use, and I can't set that from here. Please keep an eye out for a call or message within 24 hours, and if you don't hear back by then, reply here and quote ESC-700.

I also need to be accurate about what the specialist received. The case notes include your account of the situation, the courier timeline, and the $5.60 credit already issued. They also say you want the credit to reflect the full situation. However, I didn't write a specific request for the specialist to decide whether you're owed more, and I don't have a tool to edit the case. I can't promise what the specialist will decide, and I can't add compensation myself beyond what policy allows. If you want that question stated clearly, you can ask for a human specialist directly, and I can pass that request along as its own escalation.

Right. So I've been told the specialist has my complaint but not the specific question I want answered, and that the phone number they'll use isn't known. That's not exactly reassuring.

Yes, please pass it along as its own escalation. Put it plainly: I want a decision on whether I'm owed more than the $5.60 for the cold food and the app marking it delivered while the courier was 2.1 miles away. And put my number, 415-555-0232, in the case so they can reach me.

If I don't hear back within 24 hours, I'll reply here and quote ESC-700.

events.note: Courier app marked delivered 2.1 miles from the address
